# third_party

Vendored single-file libraries, unmodified, each with its licence file.
Each library is compiled by exactly one `.c` file in its folder (CMake target `braty_third_party`).
Include them as `#include "stb/stb_image.h"`, `"cjson/cJSON.h"`, `"cgltf/cgltf.h"`, `"microui/microui.h"`.

| Library | Upstream | Commit | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| stb_image, stb_image_write, stb_truetype, stb_rect_pack, stb_vorbis | github.com/nothings/stb | 6b5799bae8a1 | MIT or public domain |
| cgltf | github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf | 85cd62382dfe | MIT |
| cJSON | github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON | 6d9f2443ab07 | MIT |
| microui | github.com/rxi/microui | 0850aba86095 | MIT |

Compile definitions set for everyone (see CMakeLists.txt): `STBI_NO_STDIO`, `STBI_WRITE_NO_STDIO`,
`STB_VORBIS_NO_STDIO`, so the engine reads files only through SDL (`br_file_*`).
To use stb_vorbis declarations: `#define STB_VORBIS_HEADER_ONLY` then `#include "stb/stb_vorbis.c"`.

## Fetched by add-ons

Not in this folder: an add-on's `CMakeLists.txt` uses an installed package when CMake finds one,
else fetches the source with FetchContent and builds it static (`addons/<name>/CMakeLists.txt`).

| Library | Add-on | Upstream | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDL3_net | `net` | github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_net | release-3.2.0 | zlib |
| Mbed TLS | `tls` | github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls (release tarball `mbedtls-3.6.8.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 in `addons/tls/CMakeLists.txt`) | 3.6.8 LTS | Apache-2.0 |

Vendored with an add-on (unmodified, compiled without the engine's warning flags):

| Library | Add-on | Upstream | Commit | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| picohttpparser (`picohttpparser.c`, `.h`) in `addons/http/third_party/picohttpparser/` | `http` | github.com/h2o/picohttpparser | dd573d8fa926 (2026-10-27) | MIT (or Perl); `LICENSE` there is the notice from the source header (upstream has no licence file) |

| wslay (`lib/*.c`, `lib/*.h`, `lib/includes/wslay/wslay.h`, `wslayver.h.in`) in `addons/websocket/third_party/wslay/` | `websocket` | github.com/tatsuhiro-t/wslay | release-1.1.1 (c9a84aa6df85, 2020-06-20) | MIT (`COPYING`); its UTF-8 decoder is Bjoern Hoehrmann's, MIT, notice in `wslay_event.c` |

To update picohttpparser: copy `picohttpparser.c` and `picohttpparser.h` from the new commit over the two files, update the commit above, run `test_http_parse`.
To update wslay: see `addons/websocket/README.md` "Updating wslay" (`config.h` and `wslayver.h` are generated by `addons/websocket/CMakeLists.txt`, not copied).

Committed with an add-on:

| Data | Add-on | Upstream | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mozilla CA bundle `addons/tls/certs/cacert.pem` | `tls` | curl.se/ca/cacert.pem | "Certificate data from Mozilla as of: Thu Nov  5 04:12:01 2026 GMT" (downloaded 2026-11-22) | MPL-2.0 |

To update the bundle: download https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem over `addons/tls/certs/cacert.pem`, update the date above; CMake regenerates the C array at the next configure.
